Official

Overview

The official assigns work to the captives after asking about their strength, dexterity or intellect. His contemptuous replies expose the brutality of the slave system: a prisoner’s abilities are treated only as a way to allocate labour. [1, 2]

Kel and the slave pen

Soldiers beat Kir nearly to death. In the slave pen, Kel nurses him back to consciousness, shortens his name to Kir and offers a partnership in escape. He initially hopes to explain the mistake to the authorities; the official instead assigns work according to the prisoners’ abilities. Kel has overheard that an officer possesses a map of the catacombs. Their escape coincides with the Horror’s attack on the slave camp: guards die and the camp burns. They obtain the map and take the catacombs out of the fortress area. Kel, usually so confident, admits her unease about the dark underground route. Once outside, Kel proposes refuge with an acquaintance who collects spiders. Their relationship begins in this shared dependence: Kir needs her local knowledge, and Kel needs a partner. [3, 4, 1, 2, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10]
